decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, but the firm serves maritime customers and has invested in a niche with long naval procurement cycles, so slow early results can still be blamed on temporary causes.
The medical examination light builds on the established offer, is visibly presented on its own page and fits the announced LED direction, so management stays committed to it.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires required heavy investment in certification, are central to the industrial customer base and are publicly showcased, so commitment is strong.
The designer task light is a publicly announced relaunch of a popular, core-adjacent product, so the firm has visibly committed to it and will justify keeping it.
